summary: Iteration 9 (frontend only): Verified new confirmed-deposit + adjustable preset flows end-to-end. Login OK. FAB overlap from iteration 8 is FIXED: quick-add-fab now at right-24 (x=1768) and ai-assistant-toggle at right-6 (x=1840); both clickable with real .click(). All requested testids present. Preset popover: opens with prefilled amount, add books via POST /variable-expenses (200) with the entered value, 'Als standaard opslaan' triggers PATCH /households (200) and chip label updates from 'Boodschappen € 50' -> 'Boodschappen € 42' after reopen. Pot Storting on 'Kindje op komst' correctly posts to POST /households/{hid}/pots/{pot_id}/contribute (200) - NOT /deposit as before. Fixed-expense regression: POST /fixed-expenses 200 OK. Dashboard contribution-reminder-banner + goto-goals-link visible when a savings pot has no deposit; disappears after contribution. Goals page /doelen: after our contribute call, goal-inleg-{pot_id} flipped to 'Ingelegd deze maand: € 1' with green check, goals-reminder-banner and confirm-all-btn disappeared. Dashboard KPIs render without NaN; 'Vrij na potjes' reflects actual confirmed contributions (€ 51.528 = surplus 51.529 - € 1 contribution). savings-chart renders. Zero page errors. NOTE: because our first quick-pot storting confirmed the only unconfirmed savings pot for this month (Sep 2026), we could not exercise the per-pot confirm-inleg-btn popover UI directly on the Doelen page in the same session - but that button/popover uses the exact same POST /contribute endpoint that we did verify, and all its testids (confirm-inleg-btn/popover/amount/submit) are correctly wired in Goals.jsx.
